part.text:
Fixed the corrupted GEO distance replies in `src/util.c`.

`fixedpoint_d2string()` skipped initialization of one fractional zero when formatting values with no integer part, leaving an uninitialized byte in responses such as `0.0001`. The padding loop now includes the final fractional position.

Validated with:

```sh
docker exec cli-eval-opencode-redis__redis-11631-2832ceb4 sh -lc 'cd /testbed && ./runtest --single unit/geo'
```

All `unit/geo` tests passed. `git diff --check` also passed. No tests were modified, staged, or committed.
